# I4 · Đặt lịch hẹn

Group **I · Vận hành Clinic · bổ sung từ web** · detail screen · status: **ported**

> Web › dialog đặt lịch · chọn dịch vụ, bác sĩ, phòng trước khi chọn giờ

## Logic source
- Web: dialog đặt lịch · chọn dịch vụ, bác sĩ, phòng trước khi chọn giờ
- Web-only: logic ported from `prototype/shared/*.js` into the `shared/clinic` domain (`ClinicStore`, `transact` commands, `ClinicError` errors keep the web's Vietnamese messages).
- Permissions follow `prototype/shared/staff-context.js` (`pages` + `capabilities`) → `Session.allows` + `session.staffContext().can(...)`.
- Web `operations-ui.js` › booking dialog; `ClinicStore.validate` / `saveAppointment` (the web's error messages).

## KMP
- Route: `Routes.AppointmentForm` ("appointment-form") · app bar "Đặt lịch hẹn"
- Composable: `AppointmentFormScreen` — `pema-kmp/feature/operations/src/commonMain/kotlin/com/pema/clinic/feature/operations/OperationsGraph.kt`
- Registered by graph: `operationsGraph`
- `shared/clinic` domain functions imported by the file (shared by every screen in it): `addDays`, `block`, `clearPreparedCrmBooking`, `crmQueue`, `initials`, `minutes`, `money`, `patient`, `preparedCrmBookingInput`, `reception`, `saveAppointment`, `staffContext`, `time`, `updateService`, `validate`, `viDate`
- Shot test: `pema-kmp/feature/operations/src/jvmTest/kotlin/com/pema/clinic/feature/operations/OperationsShotTest.kt:35` → `pema-kmp/feature/operations/build/shots/I4-vs.png`
- Canvas image: `pema-kmp/design-ref/I4.png`

## Required canvas text (keep verbatim)
- 30 phút điều trị + 0 phút chuẩn bị · 300.000 ₫

## Business rules
- Entry point: the "Vận hành phòng khám" item at the end of each role's main screen (filtered by permission).
- Route parameters: `appointment-form?id={id}&patient={patient}&crmTask={crmTask}`; with crmTask, the CSKH task is marked as booked when saving succeeds.
- Doctor role: the doctor is fixed to the signed-in doctor.

## Accepted differences from the canvas
- Web seed data (DAY = 2026-09-20, P001 Nguyễn Minh Linh) instead of the canvas's illustrative names/dates.
